Coati 0.1.0-alpha is the first pre-release of Coati: a Python package and command line tool that read the netCDF and HDF5 result files of Calliope, PyPSA and AdOpT-NET0 and write what a solved model says as JSON, in the same terms for every framework. It needs none of the frameworks, nor xarray: h5py and NumPy suffice.

It is an alpha. The layout of the documents is versioned on its own (`schema_version` 1.0) and is meant to stay; the Python interface and the command line may still change between pre-releases. If a document says something other than what a framework says about the same file, please [open an issue](https://github.com/enerplanet/Coati/issues) with the file and the two numbers.

## Highlights

- **One document for every framework.** `coati SOURCE OUTPUT FRAMEWORK` writes the capacities, generation, dispatch, demand, the exchange between locations and the costs of a solved model. A key means the same whichever framework solved the model, and the document holds what [TEMPO](https://github.com/THD-Spatial-AI/TEMPO) reads.
- **The framework is named with its version and checked.** `calliope-v0-6-10`, `pypsa-v1-2-4`, `adopt-net0-v0-1-10`: the identifier is a claim about the file, and a file of another framework or layout is refused. Without it, Coati takes the framework from the file.
- **Reads the bundles of MEME 0.1.0-alpha.** Every scenario and example of [MEME](https://github.com/enerplanet/meme) 0.1.0-alpha was run on every target that accepts it: 133 jobs, of which 130 ran through (three failed in the solvers of MEME) and left 172 result files. Every document agrees with what PyPSA 1.2.4, Calliope 0.7.0, Calliope 0.6.8 and AdOpT-NET0 0.1.10 themselves report for the file.
- **Everything a file holds.** `coati dump` writes the groups, dimensions, variables and attributes of any netCDF or HDF5 file, with the values read according to the CF conventions.
- **Strict JSON.** `NaN` and the infinities become `null`, a string or an error, as the caller chooses; a file is replaced only once its document is complete.

## Frameworks

| Identifier | Framework | Versions | Tested with | Formats |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `calliope-v0-6` | Calliope | 0.6.x | 0.6.8, 0.6.10 | netCDF-4 |
| `calliope-v0-7` | Calliope | 0.7.x | 0.7.0.dev7, 0.7.0 | netCDF-4 |
| `pypsa-v0` | PyPSA | 0.25 and later 0.x | 0.25.2, 0.35.2 | netCDF-4, HDF5 |
| `pypsa-v1` | PyPSA | 1.x | 1.2.4, 1.3.0 | netCDF-4, HDF5 |
| `adopt-net0-v0-1` | AdOpT-NET0 | 0.1.x | 0.1.10 | HDF5 |

## Getting it

```bash
pip install enerplanet-coati               # once the package is on PyPI
pip install enerplanet_coati-0.1.0a0-py3-none-any.whl   # the wheel attached below
coati results.nc results.json calliope-v0-7-0
```

Python 3.10 or newer. The package is called `enerplanet-coati` on PyPI, the Python package and the command `coati`; `0.1.0a0` is how Python writes the version `0.1.0-alpha`.

Documentation: <https://enerplanet.github.io/Coati> (quickstart, command line, Python package, how each key follows from a file of each framework, the documents and their schemas, reading the bundles of MEME).

## What changed

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/enerplanet/Coati/blob/v0.1.0-alpha/CHANGELOG.md#010-alpha---2026-10-25).

## Known limitations

- The shadow prices of Calliope and PyPSA are not read.
- AdOpT-NET0 0.1.10 writes the node design, the operation and the energy balances of the last investment period in place of those of every period; Coati warns about such a file and cannot restore what it lacks. Its emissions are reported under `details.summary` as totals only.
- A PyPSA network that was optimised in several steps, or with an objective of its own, has an objective that is no cost; the document reports what the system costs as `objective` and what PyPSA recorded as `objective_function_value`, with a warning.
- Calliope 0.6 needs a version of Python that Coati does not support, so its files are tested from files that were made once; the other frameworks are also solved anew by the tests.
